Key item features

  • Immersive Audio : Bose Immersive Audio spatializes sound, placing it in front of you for an acoustic sweet spot and a more natural listening experience.
  • Cinema Mode : New Cinema Mode enhances video content by spatializing and balancing background sound and effects for a movie-like experience.
  • Superior Noise Cancellation : Features Bose's best noise cancellation, effectively silencing airplane hum, office chatter, and other distractions for uninterrupted listening.
  • Personalized Sound : CustomTune technology analyzes ear shape to adapt audio performance, delivering crystal-clear, lossless sound via USB audio.
  • Premium Comfort : Designed with a premium polish, refined metal materials, plush ear cushions, and an evenly distributing headband for all-day comfort.
  • Extended Battery : Offers up to 30 hours of battery life, or 23 hours with Immersive Audio, and allows simultaneous charging and listening.
  • Bluetooth Connectivity : Easily connects to devices using Bluetooth Core 5.4, with paired devices manageable through the Bose app.
